create.name: Mark Bentley
create.bio:
Mark Bentley is an Australian Gene Keys guide and ambassador who also works with Human Design. He came to this work by a winding road: a performing career, a spell managing nightclubs in Norway, then a motorcycle accident in his mid-twenties that slowed him down and turned him towards self-inquiry. Meeting José Argüelles's Law of Time and the Mayan Dreamspell calendar in Peru opened a long spiritual search. He later trained in Human Design, becoming a certified Living Your Design guide, and studied the Gene Keys with their author Richard Rudd.

His main offer is one-to-one sessions in which he reads a person's Gene Keys profile, and Human Design chart where useful, to look at gifts, relationships and life purpose; couples sessions are also possible. He has facilitated Gene Keys workshops in several countries, supports Gene Keys online retreats, and taught a seven-week Gene Keys course with The Shift Network. For several years he recorded short weekly contemplations on the Gene Key of the week and on the Dreamspell cycles for his YouTube channel, and he writes longer reflections on individual Gene Keys on his blog. He is curious about where science, technology and spirituality meet.
